codeforces.selection: data/train-*.parquet and data/test-*.parquet; statement fields only; excludes verifiable-prompts duplicates

dapo.dedup: SHA256 of exact canonical JSON prompt messages; verify content equality on collision

gpqa.distribution: official author GitHub dataset.zip; password documented by author README; no HF login or acceptance

longbench.selection: original 21 v1 subtasks; exclude _e length-balanced duplicate variant

openscience.selection: uniform without replacement over ALL rows in pinned converted parquet for each config; partial-train configs explicitly partial, never full corpus representative

measurement.raw: explicit task prompt, no chat wrapper, add_special_tokens=false
measurement.chat: same task prompt as one user message, no system, add_generation_prompt=true, enable_thinking=false, tokenize=true
measurement.filter: only missing/non-string/empty required input rejected and counted; no length filter
